description: This PHP class 'InterviewAttachmentsController' handles the pre-render setup for interview attachment views within a recruitment plugin. It manages authorization, retrieves interview data, configures Vue components, and uses traits for services related to configuration, user roles, and candidates.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentsController
classes.description: Controller for managing interview attachment views, including permission checks, fetching interview data, and configuring the Vue.js component for the interview attachments page.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with interview ID, max file size, and allowed file types after fetching the interview by ID, throws exception if interview not found.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the specific interview by verifying permissions via user role manager.
